title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG The Eye of Truth Pharaoh's Servant PSV-010 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. The Eye of Truth, a Trap-Continuous card from the Pharaoh's Servant set, is a common card with a card number of PSV-010. Its features include a 1st Edition and it belongs to the CCG Individual Cards and Collectible Card Games categories. 

The card is perfect for those who love the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game and is a great addition to any collection. Its character, The Eye of Truth, is a fascinating one and the card is sure to impress any fan. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing card.
